blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Federation of Free Farmers (FFF) has welcomed the government’s 60-day restriction on certain pork imports but questioned the Department of Agriculture’s (DA) delay in implementing the measure, saying the agency should have acted sooner as rising imports and frozen pork inventories continued to drive down prices received by local hog raisers. In a statement, the group said the influx of imported pork had pushed farmgate prices below break-even levels, threatening the livelihoods of domestic hog producers.
